core.title: First Impressions White Replacement Rubber Tip
tags: Replacement Rubber White tip For Baseboard Door Bumpers

text.description_html:
First Impressions DS-RUBBER, Door Stop Rubber Tip

Rubber Color: White

This is a replacement rubber tip for the First Impressions Baseboard Door Stops. Fits
DS-SS-2 2" Baseboard Door Stop, DS-SS-4.5 4-1/2" Baseboard Door Stop, DS-SS-5.5 5-1/2" Baseboard Door Stop, and DS-SS-6.5 6-1/2" Baseboard Door Stop.

Note: The door stop does NOT have to be removed from the door to replace the tip.

Warning: These work for Baseboard Door Stops manufactured by First Impressions. If you are not sure if your door stops were manufactured by First Impressions, do NOT order these as they may not work properly.

*Sold individually - NO RETURNS
